name: switch-choice-card
title: Switch: Choice Card
description: Card-style selection where `FieldLabel` wraps the entire `Field` for a clickable card pattern.

files.content:
import {
  Field,
  FieldContent,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLabel,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/field";
import { Switch } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/switch";

export const SwitchChoiceCard = () => (
  <FieldGroup className="w-full max-w-sm">
    <Field variant="card" orientation="horizontal">
      <FieldContent>
        <FieldLabel>Share across devices</FieldLabel>
        <FieldDescription>
          Focus is shared across devices, and turns off when you leave the app.
        </FieldDescription>
      </FieldContent>
      <Switch />
    </Field>
    <Field variant="card" orientation="horizontal">
      <FieldContent>
        <FieldLabel>Enable notifications</FieldLabel>
        <FieldDescription>
          Receive notifications when focus mode is enabled or disabled.
        </FieldDescription>
      </FieldContent>
      <Switch defaultChecked />
    </Field>
  </FieldGroup>
);
